about: Parnate (tranylcypromine), by brand name only, is supplied seven times from September 2025 to March 2026 (30 mg a day).
Tranylcypromine (Parnate) 10 mg, four tablets a day (40 mg a day), is supplied three times from December 2025 to February 2026, in the middle of a 15-month history.
Moclobemide, a different and reversible MAO inhibitor that is not on the list, is supplied monthly. Tranylcypromine does not appear.
